name: House of Yes
address: 2 Wyckoff Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11237 (entrance around the corner at 408 Jefferson St)
status_note: Official calendar lists events through Oct 2026 (Halloween run incl. Dirty Circus, Vampire Ball) and into Dec 2026. Venue notes it sometimes closes for private events.

dress.detail: The official FAQ says Friday and Saturday parties are themed and to 'dress to express'; other nights, wear what makes you feel fun and fabulous. Time Out notes guests are known for elaborate costumes.

age.value: 21+ with government photo ID (except events marked All Ages)

cover.value: Ticketed per event; Dirty Circus GA ~$43, cabaret table for 2 ~$77; party tickets tiered and rise closer to the date

sources.name: House of Yes FAQ (official, prices rise closer to date)

getting_in.value: Buy advance tickets on the official calendar; limited door sales first-come, first-served until capacity. Some tickets require arrival before 11pm or 1:30am.

hours.value: Event-driven: shows usually start 6:30pm (Thu-Sat), dance parties 9-10:30pm onward Thu-Sat and some Wednesdays; end times not published

price.value: Mid-range ($$ of $$$$); cocktails were ~$13 in older press, current prices not published

accessibility.value: Official: all entrances and spaces are single-level and wheelchair accessible; reserved seating for guests with physical disabilities; strobe lights often used

skip_if: You hate lines: Time Out says the entry queue often runs down the block, so buy tickets ahead and arrive early.
Strobes or sensory overload are a problem: the venue warns strobe lights are often used.
